title: Kranthiveera Sangolli Rayanna
desc: Sangolli Rayanna, the army chief of the Kingdom of Kittur and a freedom fighter, revolts against the British in a bid to oust them from the country.

title: Vaalee
desc: A man with a hearing and speech impairment secretly loves his twin brother's wife. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages, where men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.

title: Gajanana & Gang
desc: Gaja, a young man known for his calm demeanour, is forced to join hands with his college friends and rebel against his seniors after they display unruly behaviour.

title: Brahmastra: Part One - Shiva
desc: With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.

title: V
desc: A celebrated police officer's run of success is shockingly interrupted by V, a mysterious killer, who specifically challenges him to end his killing spree.

title: Kiragoorina Gayyaligalu
desc: A village living in harmony faces challenges when politicians try to divide the people based on caste. Subsequently, female villagers take up the task of fighting the oppressors.

title: Bhaagamathie
desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

title: Gajendragada Ganesha
desc: A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.
